Key Features: Fully Automatic: Enjoy instant access to your favorite shows with the touch of a button. No manual adjustments required – it’s as simple as press and play. Quiet Operation: The updated design of the T4 not only provides improved tracking of satellites but does so with significantly reduced noise. Compact Size: Winegard's smallest in-motion antenna takes up minimal roof space and eliminates the need for storage space. Multi-Provider Compatibility: Whether you prefer DISH, DIRECTV, or Bell TV, the T4 is capable of receiving signals from any of these services. matches_set.description: Compatible with: Linro 253. See part QU66427 for the rest. Part QU14513 also fits: DRT 7020. 50kHz-500MHz Active Magnetic Loop Antenna Amplifier for SDR Receivers This wideband active magnetic loop antenna kit is designed for receive-only radio and SDR applications from 50kHz to 500MHz. It combines a compact loop assembly, active amplifier, switchable configuration board, feeder cables, mounting hooks, and a storage case for bench, indoor, or portable receiving setups. Key Features Wide receive range: 50kHz-500MHz for compatible HF, AM, FM, VHF, UHF, and SDR receiving equipment. Active front end: Listed gain of 17dB at 10MHz for improving received signal level. Configurable loop: The amplifier and jumper boards provide switch-selectable loop configurations for different receiving environments. Compact installation: Supplied loop sections, feeder cables, adhesive hooks, and carrying case support fixed or portable setups. Receive-only design: Intended for signal reception and spectrum monitoring, not RF transmission. Technical Specifications Receiving frequency range: 50kHz-500MHz Gain: 17dB at 10MHz Output noise: -125dBm at 10MHz, BW=100Hz P1dB: +15.5dBm at 10MHz OIP3: +38dBm at 10M
matches_set.listing_caption: 50kHz-500MHz Active Magnetic Loop Antenna Amplifier for SDR Receiver [QU31875]
